QuoteProvider.reason: Prices and splits from Yahoo Finance; built in the Yahoo adapter issue.

DividendProvider.reason: Dividends from Yahoo Finance; built in the Yahoo adapter issue.

FundamentalsProvider.reason: Yearly fundamentals from StatusInvest; built in the StatusInvest adapter issue, after its terms are read.

StatementProvider.reason: Financial statements from CVM ITR and DFP; built in the CVM statements issue.

FundDataProvider.reason: Monthly FII data from StatusInvest; built in the StatusInvest adapter issue.

FilingProvider.reason: Filing lists from CVM IPE and FNET; built in the CVM filings issue and the FNET issue.

DocumentProvider.reason: Document download and text for CVM and FNET filings; built in the document text issue.

MacroProvider.reason: Macro series from BCB SGS; built in the BCB adapter issue.
